title: Uncertainty-Guided Agents for Rare-Disease Hypothesis Discovery on Knowledge Graphs

contributions.purpose: 不确定性引导的闭环多智能体 KG 发现
contributions.mechanism: 打分器(逻辑回归+特征 dropout 近似 MC 不确定性)+ UCB 采集规划器(â=p̂+λσ)+ 校准审计器
contributions.evaluation: 固定预算下更早发现真链;消融 λ=0 退化为 greedy 证明探索项关键
contributions.domain: 生物医学 KG/主动学习
contributions.source_quote: A reproducible multi-agent pipeline for rare-disease KG discovery that leverages uncertainty-guided experiment selection to improve sample efficiency.

contributions.mechanism: 合成 KG(500 药/2000 靶点/100 罕见病),可控 sparsity(3–5%)与 noise(0–20%)
contributions.evaluation: disease-wise split 留出未见疾病评估
contributions.source_quote: The design and implementation of a synthetic benchmark environment that captures the key challenges of sparsity and noise inherent in rare-disease research.

contributions.purpose: 证明优于启发式/静态基线
contributions.mechanism: AUPRC/Hit@10/累积遗憾对比 + 稳健性扫描
contributions.evaluation: 平均 +0.10 AUPRC、+0.9 Hit@10;留出 AUPRC 0.819;高噪高稀疏优雅退化(AUPRC 0.869→0.658,高稀疏 0.616→0.506)
contributions.source_quote: Empirical validation demonstrating significant gains over heuristic and static baselines across multiple metrics

notes: 数据红旗:完全合成 KG(自认 limitation 'cannot capture the full spectrum of biological complexity'),循环自证、无任何真实生物医学 KG 验证。幻影/未完成文本:§4.3 句子 'For instance, within the first 20' 中断(占位符/未写完),下一行直接跳到 4.4。trade-off 带数字(稳健性表)。ECE<0.05、高置信段 precision>0.95(自证可信)。checklist 自称多为人类主导[A/B]。decision=reject。
